coverage.evidence_summary: Complete M49 054 island fabric reviewed through institutional and academic sources and eight checked sites; no unsupported hard local frontier or country-based M49 correction is asserted.
All 414 assignments replace modern scaffold actors for exactly 1444-11-11 with conservative local community or chiefly fabrics.

Date-valid records keep New Guinea, Bismarck-Bougainville, Solomon, Vanuatu, Fijian, and Kanak community fabrics distinct and avoid projecting later paramount chiefdoms backward.
